annotations.title: Screen Stocks by Listing Risk (Deficiency, Deadline, Hearing, Reverse Split, Pending Suspension)

description: Screen US-listed stocks by exchange listing risk. Filters (all must match): deficiencyTypes (open notices), maxDaysToDeadline (open notice whose deadline is 0..N days away; deadlineBasis on each row says whether the exchange or an accepted plan stated it or it is a Signal8 estimate), hearingDeadlineWithinDays (computed hearing request deadline of an open Staff Delisting Determination), panelExceptionEndsWithinDays (a Hearings Panel exception deadline), reverseSplitNeeded (an open bid-price notice and a last price below $1.00; not a statement that the company will split), reverseSplitNearCap (cumulative reverse splits over two years within 20x of the 1-for-250 cap), pendingSuspension (on the exchange pending suspension list as last read), and price, market cap and float bounds. At least one listing-risk filter is required. Rows carry the open notices, deadlines with their basis, hearing deadline, reverse-split headroom and the pending list entry. Tickers a filter could not judge are excluded and counted in excludedNotMeasured, so an empty result is not evidence of compliance.

deficiencyTypes.description: Open deficiency notice of one of these types.

hearingDeadlineWithinDays.description: Hearing request deadline within N days (0-60).

maxDaysToDeadline.description: Open notice deadline within N days (0-90).

panelExceptionEndsWithinDays.description: Panel exception deadline within N days (0-365).

pendingSuspension.description: true: on the exchange pending suspension / delisting list.

reverseSplitNearCap.description: true: cumulative 2-year reverse splits near the 1-for-250 cap.

reverseSplitNeeded.description: true: open bid-price notice and last price below $1.00.
